notes.title: 5/17 (Wed) STEAM Purchase Abnormality Announcement
notes.content:
Dear players,

We have discovered an issue with STEAM where purchase cannot be processed normally.

The development team is currently investigating the issue.

We will make an announcement once there is an update on the situation.

We apologize for any inconvenience caused during this time.

notes.title: 5/17(Wed)13:00~16:00(GMT+8)All Servers Maintenance Notice
notes.content:
Dear players,

Eden Eternal is going to perform the first maintenance.
The entire server will be under maintenance from 13:00 to 16:00 on 5/17(Wed), 

 

The following content will be available after the maintenance:

1. Character’s maximum level increase to 50

2. New class "Blade Dancer" unlocked

3. Main quests "Delphi Forest" unlocked

 

Please log out in advance to a safe zone.

 

The further notice will be announced if there are any changes to the maintenance schedule.

Due to some players having excessively long character names,

it has affected in-game functions (such as whispering and mailing),

 

To avoid unnecessary error in the game,

the character name length encoding mechanism will be adjusted after this maintenance,

Characters with names exceeding 9 (inclusive) full-width characters or 17 (inclusive) half-width characters,

will be forcibly renamed after the maintenance,

We apologize for any inconvenience caused to the players.

 
※1 Chinese or Japanese character is equivalent to 1 full-width character or 2 half-width characters

※1 English letter or number is equivalent to 1 half-width character

 
X-Legend Team

notes.title: How to activate OTP Authenticator to increase your account security
notes.content:
Hi brave adventurers!

We have launched a new security protection mechanism called the [OTP Authenticator]. Players can use the "Google Authenticator" app to bind and verify their accounts, reducing the risk of account theft. Let's see how to apply for it.

Step 1: On your mobile device, go to the "App Store" or "Google Play Store" and download the "Google Authenticator" app.

Step 2: Log in to the member center of [Eden Eternal] on our official website. Choose [OTP Application] to enter the application process for the authenticator.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/7i28wp9.jpg[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/CcIsu9G.jpg[/img]

Step 3: After clicking on the logo, open the app and select "Begin Setup" -> "Scan Barcode". Scan the QR code, and a series of numbers will appear.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/8f83ycZ.jpg[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/HR1r02h.jpg[/img]

Step 4: Enter the obtained number in the space provided for [Enter Token], and click "Next". A message will appear below confirming the successful binding.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZvhNfAg.jpg[/img]

Please note that the input should only contain six digits, without any spaces or other symbols.

If you encounter the message "Two-step verification failed. Please enter a valid verification code" even when you have entered the correct number, it might be due to the following reasons:
(1) Time discrepancy between your mobile device and Google's server time.

Troubleshooting:

Enable the [Automatic Date & Time] setting on your mobile device.
For Android users, after completing Step 1, go to the app's settings page and select "Adjust Code Time" -> "Sync Now" -> restart the app and proceed with the binding using the displayed code.
(2) Incorrect entry or expired verification code within the valid timeframe.

Troubleshooting:
The verification code has a specific validity period. The app will display a six-digit code along with its expiration time. If it turns red, it means the code is about to expire. You will be provided with a new code afterward. Please make sure to complete the relevant process within the valid timeframe.

Step 5: After completing the setup, when you open the game and reach the login interface, enter your correct account credentials. A verification webpage will appear. At this point, open your app and enter the six-digit number displayed above your account into the [Enter Verification Code] field on the verification webpage. Click "Verify". If entered correctly, a message will appear.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/QLpOHQe.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/hjdLQli.png[/img]

Afterward, click the back button in the top left corner to log in to the game normally.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/YNBIplY.jpg[/img]
Once the verification is successful, you won't need to verify again when logging in from the same device within seven days.
To cancel the OTP Authenticator:

Step 1: Go to the in-game store interface and click on [AIHELP]. Report your request to cancel the OTP verification and provide your login IP location (which can be found through online searches) for verification by our staff.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/U8Tj9nB.jpg[/img]
Step 2: After the customer service staff assists with the cancellation, proceed to delete the app.

Please note that if you directly perform Step 2 without going through Step 1 to apply for cancellation, your account will remain in a bound state, and you won't be able to log in normally in the future.

Thank you and enjoy the game!

Best regards from the X-LEGEND team!

notes.title: Happy Mother's Day
notes.content:
Hi brave adventurers!

Do you still remember that Mother's Day is coming up on 5/14 (Sunday)? No matter how busy you are, please remember to take some time to express gratitude to your mother!

The Mother's Day event "Assistant Teren's Flower" is now open. 
During the event period "2023/05/10 (Wed) ~ 05/24 (Wed)", players level 30 and above can go to Aven and find the NPC "Assistant Teren (308, 392)" to receive the "Floriculture Part". After using the Floriculture Part, players can receive it again every 2 hours of being online, with a chance to obtain the "Pink Daisy" and limited costumes.

Meanwhile, in "Eden Eternal" ,we are also hosting an event called "Happy Mother's Day" during Mother's Day. Additionally, as a special treat for celebrating Mother's Day, we have a limited-time offer. Enter the event code WELOVEMOM in the game to receive the following rewards: - Safety Stone x 5 - Memory Tome x 1 - Portal Stone x 40.

We hope you can enjoy this special event in the game and don't forget to wish everyone a Happy Mother's Day!

Wishing you all a fantastic weekend!

Best regards from the X-LEGEND team!

notes.title: 5/4~5/14 Get Ready for an Infinite Supply of Reward Codes!
notes.content:
[b]Get Ready for an Infinite Supply of Reward Codes![/b]
To celebrate the milestone of reaching the pre-registration goal and the official launch of the game, the development team has prepared various universal serial codes for players to redeem. Players are reminded to check for the latest codes every two days!

New codes will be released at 12:00 (GMT+8) on the day of announcement, so please remember to check back regularly.

 
To redeem the activity codes, players can click on "Reward Code" in the bottom right corner of the Item Mall (I) to open the redemption window and enter the code to claim the reward.

After redeeming the code, players can switch channels or log out and log back in to see the reward in the "Claim" section of the Item Mall.

Please click the link to find out codes (Daily update)
[url=https://www.x-legend.com/online/edeneternal/en/news_in.php?nid=18160]Code is here[/url]

[b]※The items obtained through code redemption cannot be traded.

※The serial codes are valid until July 31, 2023. Please take advantage of this opportunity to claim your rewards[/b]

notes.content:

notes.title: Welcome back, brave adventurers!
notes.content:
Welcome back, brave adventurers!

We are thrilled to announce that "[b]Eden Eternal[/b]" the game you all love and have been waiting for, has finally returned! We appreciate your patience and are committed to provide you with an even better and more exciting gaming experience than before.

Whether you are a newbie or an experienced adventurer, we will bring you endless fun and excitement. We X-LEGEND have always strived to create the most stunning game worlds, allowing you to explore, battle, cooperate, and forge genuine connections with players from all over the world.

Moreover, countless quests, levels, items, and special events to the game, offering a gaming experience like never before as well as we promise to continuously update and expand the game to ensure that your gameplay is always enjoyable.

We are excited to have you back and look forward to embarking on new adventures together.

Warm regards from the X-LEGEND team!
